summary: Expiry-day preview amid global chaos: Dow making ~1000-point daily swings; Fed chair warned US may not avoid recession; UK inflation above 9%; FII June selling second-highest on record; rupee at fresh all-time low. Expects flat open and volatile expiry; 17,400-17,500 straddle (~150-160 premium) favored.

events.claim: Fed Chair Powell said (June 2022) he is determined to bring down inflation with rate hikes but may not be able to avoid a US recession
UK inflation above 9% (June 2022), triggering a sharp UK selloff
FII cash-market selling in June 2022 was the second-highest month on record (after COVID month)
Indian rupee hit fresh all-time low vs USD in late June 2022

lessons: If FIIs park sale proceeds in Indian debt instruments, it signals correction-and-return; moving money out of India signals longer exit.
Expect 5-10% swings either way until inflation clarity emerges; position sizing must assume it.
quote: Markets may not correct significantly but at the same time market may not go higher also significantly - up down up down at least for another six months.
leaks: 'Hi, this is P. R. Sundar' (real name)

summary: Violent June expiry: after flat open Nifty shot up 200+ points intraday, then fell 270 points from high; Bank Nifty swung 800 points intraday; far OTM options whipsawed 5-to-50 rupees repeatedly. FII sold 2,400 cr, DII bought 2,400 cr. Auto index +5% (Maruti +500), IT +2%, Reliance dragged. Option sellers had a nightmare week.

events.claim: FII cash selling exceeded 50,000 crore in June 2022 - third month above 50,000 crore; two consecutive months >1 lakh crore, a record
Auto index rose ~5% on 23 Jun 2022 with Maruti up ~500 rupees despite crude staying high
Nifty fell ~270 points from intraday high on 23 Jun 2022 expiry and Bank Nifty ~800 points

lessons: When every 100-point gap keeps extending in the same direction day after day, the gap day itself is the trade - fade nothing until the pattern breaks.
Expiry-day intraday whipsaws (5-to-50 rupee option swings) destroy option sellers even with modest India VIX - size down on expiry days in high-vol regimes.
quote: Five rupees option went to fifty rupees, from fifty again came to five, again from five it went to fifty - such a hugely volatile market.
leaks: 'I am going for a party... resorts in ECR' (location hint)

summary: US rose despite the Fed recession warning - bad news ignored near bottoms, he argues. SGX opened above Thursday's high despite FII selling ~17,000 cr in five sessions (likely a weekly record). Reliance dragged (2,800 to 2,450), banks/auto/IT supported; TCS swung 600 rupees in days. Auto-sector outperformance thesis (multi-year bear run ending); bought Hero MotoCorp ~2,500.

events.claim: FIIs sold ~17,000 crore in cash market in the five sessions ending 24 Jun 2022, likely the highest weekly selling ever (excluding COVID)
Accenture results missed estimates (June 2022) but stock closed nearly flat
Hero MotoCorp planned a price hike for its motorcycles (late June 2022)

lessons: Bad news ignored near lows signals a bottom; bad news ignored at highs signals a top.
In bear markets, buy high-dividend-yield stocks - downside limited and they pay you to wait (but even those can halve, e.g. REC 200+ to under 100).
quote: Usually bad news will be ignored at the top, good news will be ignored at the bottom... if bad news is ignored at the bottom, that means bottom is very near.
leaks: 'I have one friend in Dubai... I did my first trade in US markets through his account' (personal/structure hint)

summary: Gap-up sustained: Nifty +200, Bank Nifty +600 with no intraday sell-off; yet India VIX ROSE and premiums did not decay - extreme fear persisted. Option volumes collapsed (sellers wiped out by a month of zigzags); intraday short straddles lost ~1%/day for a month (~30% capital). FII sold 2,300 cr, DII bought 2,200 cr; monthly FII selling 53,600 cr vs May's 54,300 cr.

events.claim: June 2022 FII cash selling reached ~53,600 crore by 24 Jun, just shy of May 2022's ~54,300 crore
Bank Nifty gapped up ~500 points and held gains on 24 Jun 2022
Intraday short straddle in Bank Nifty on 24 Jun 2022 yielded ~2,500 rupees profit per lot (entered 9:30)

lessons: When premiums stay bid and VIX rises on a big up day, the crowd fears a trap - respect that signal before adding bullish exposure.
A strategy losing 1% of capital daily compounds to ~30% monthly damage: survival means standing aside when your edge regime disappears.
quote: If a person loses 1% per day for 30 days, 30% of the capital is wiped out... the last one month has been a nightmare for option sellers.
leaks: 'I am going to Dubai, spending about a week' (residence hint)

summary: Markets rallying on bad news worldwide: Russia's foreign-debt default over the weekend, prior week Nasdaq +7.5% after Fed recession warning. SGX gap-up 150 points; FII selling continues (2,500-3,000 cr/day). 16,000 now resistance; option writers conservative (volumes below one-year average). Advice: sell only far strikes; capital protection over profit.

events.claim: Russia defaulted on its foreign-currency sovereign debt (June 2022)
Nasdaq rallied ~7.5% in the week to 24 Jun 2022 despite the Fed recession warning
India VIX around 20 while Nifty made 200+ point daily swings (late June 2022)

lessons: Bear-market rallies are fast and ferocious - symmetric to bull-market corrections; both kill unprepared traders.
When volatility is extreme, sell only far-from-money strikes: in such markets protecting capital matters more than making profit.
quote: If there is at least one day markets trade without any intraday fall of more than 100 points, that is when you can assume volatility will subside.

summary: After Monday's 200+ gap-up, SGX now indicates a 70-point gap-down on weak US/Asia; 15,700 (reclaimed breakdown level) treated as support until Wednesday's US GDP. FIIs still heavily short in index futures (~85%+) despite Nifty +700 off 15,200; little short covering. Reliance weak below 2,500; upside seen limited until GDP data.

events.claim: US Q2 2022 GDP data (first estimate) due 28 Jul... (speaker says Wednesday 29 Jun 2022) and expected to confirm recession
RBI deputy governor warned of a 'black swan' risk from sustained FII selling (June 2022)
FIIs held ~85%+ short position in Nifty index futures in late June 2022

lessons: When a market rallies 700 points and futures shorts barely cover, the crowd conviction is bearish - the fuel for any squeeze is measured by what remains, not what covered.
Opening above the prior high or below the prior low is technically significant; treat those breaks as regime tells.
quote: Yesterday's high should be the high for another one or two days, until the US GDP data.

summary: Opened 100 points lower, tested and held 15,700 support, then recovered on Reliance strength: Mukesh Ambani stepped down as Reliance Jio chairman (son taking over), stoking Jio/Retail separate-IPO speculation. US GDP due next day; VIX rising on up AND down days flagged as pre-storm behavior; 15,800 straddle (~200 premium) implies 15,600-16,000.

events.claim: Mukesh Ambani stepped down as chairman of Reliance Jio; his son took over (June 2022), fueling separate Jio IPO expectations
US Q1 2022 GDP (third estimate) due 29 Jun 2022; markets feared a recession signal

lessons: When VIX rises whether the market goes up or down, something is being priced in - reduce size before the storm rather than interpret after it.
A governance change (succession) at an index heavyweight can move the whole index via sentiment and IPO optionality, even with fundamentals unchanged.
quote: Market goes up also VIX going up, market goes down also VIX going up... something can happen in the next few days.
leaks: 'one of my friends is taking me to a great height... 122nd floor of Burj Khalifa' (location/personal)

summary: US consumer-sentiment data revised inflation expectations up to ~8% (from ~5.9% implied a week earlier) - Nasdaq -4%, Dow swung ~1,000 points, wiping half a week's gains in one session. US GDP + Powell speech same day. SGX below 15,700 support (technically bearish); range seen 15,600-15,930; sold puts 15,400-15,600 and calls 15,900-16,000, planning intraday exits only.

events.claim: University of Michigan consumer survey (late June 2022) showed 1-year inflation expectations ~8% after an earlier reading implying ~5.3-5.9%, crashing US markets
Nasdaq fell ~4% in the session before 29 Jun 2022 after the sentiment data
April fools / May mayhem / June [disaster]: June 2022 among the worst series for option sellers

lessons: When shorting and short-covering dominate (not investment flows), intraday swings dwarf close-to-close moves - trade the reaction, not the forecast.
The market rewards the minority: when everyone positions for the binary event the same way, the event usually moves against the majority.
quote: When there is bad news, people short heavily; when there is good news, people cover shorts - this shorting and short covering makes the market too volatile.

summary: US Q1 GDP revised to -1.6% (vs -1.5% expected) yet US ignored it - already priced after a 1,000-point Dow drop. Reliance-Jio news drove India's recovery; TCS making violent two-way moves; Nifty futures ~20-30 point discount into expiry hinting bearish bias. Stability only when the Fed slows to 25bp hikes (Sept/Oct at the earliest). His Reliance 2,500CE/2,600CE spread into expiry.

events.claim: US Q1 2022 GDP came at -1.6% (second estimate, 29 Jun 2022) vs -1.5% expected; markets shrugged
Nifty futures closed 20+ points below spot on 29 Jun 2022 (unusual discount into expiry)

lessons: Once a market has absorbed a shock (1,000-point Dow drop), a slightly worse headline loses its power - sequencing of news matters more than the news.
Futures discount/premium shifts into expiry are a positioning tell: persistent discount hints at bearish bias in the resolution.
quote: The market will stabilize only when the Fed increases rates by just 25 basis points - and that is not going to happen in July or August.

summary: July series opened brutal: Reliance crashed ~8% on the government's new windfall tax on petrol/diesel/ATF exports, single-handedly dragging Nifty ~150 points (of a ~300-point fall). ITC was the top gainer. Five rebound signals: VIX fell on a big down day; the fall was one-stock-driven; Europe recovered; futures discount (60 points, rare) wiped out to premium; FII selling slowed below 1,000 cr/day.

events.claim: India imposed a windfall tax on petrol, diesel and aviation turbine fuel exports on 1 July 2022; Reliance fell ~8% intraday
Reliance contributed ~150 points of Nifty's fall on 1 Jul 2022 (12-13% index weight)
Nifty's next-month futures traded ~60 points below the current-month future at June expiry - an unusually wide calendar discount

lessons: A 12% index-weight stock falling 8% is a mechanical ~1% index hit: always know your index's heavyweight concentration risk.
Futures calendar-spread discount collapsing to premium is a classic short-covering tell - more reliable than opinion.
quote: From that time onwards the Nifty future was actually trading slightly premium to spot... that indicated very clearly that the short sellers were covering their shorts.
leaks: 'yesterday night only I flew from Dubai to Delhi' (travel/residence hint)
Tamil beggar joke told in Tamil (language identity marker)

summary: Flat open after US holiday; windfall tax already priced into Reliance/ONGC/Vedanta (dividend yields cushion the latter two). Banking stuck in violent 33,000-34,000 range; 'companies give value, the market gives valuation' ahead of bank business updates. TCS results Friday - pre-result short-covering thesis. FII futures short ~85%, a record start to a series; Nirmala-Sitharaman-candle shock-therapy analogy invoked.

events.claim: FIIs started July 2022 with ~85% short position in Nifty index futures - a record short positioning
Bank Nifty futures ranged 33,000-34,000 in early July 2022 with violent intraday moves

lessons: When everyone holds the same extreme position, one policy surprise (a 'shock therapy' like a tax cut) forces a violent unwind - extremes are fuel, not forecasts.
Value and valuation are different things: rosy business updates are value; the price the market pays is valuation.
quote: Companies give value and the stock market gives the valuation.
leaks: 'Nirmala Sitharaman candle' (named policy event - keep as historical term only)

summary: Bank Nifty surged past 34,000 (ICICI-led) on strong Q1 bank business updates; ITC, FMCG and high-dividend names (REC 110 to 127 in two weeks) led; metals lagged despite his expectations. Option writers regained confidence: 15,700PE + 16,000CE combined ~120 premium implying 15,600-16,100 safety zone. Volatility seen rising again at month-end US CPI/Fed (Jul 28-29). Long Dubai-conference announcement (promo segment).

events.claim: Indian banks' Q1 FY23 business updates (loan growth, CASA) triggered a Bank Nifty rally past 34,000 on 4 Jul 2022
REC rose ~15% in two weeks (110 to 127) in June-July 2022
US Fed meeting scheduled 27-28 July 2022; US CPI due mid-July - volatility windows

lessons: High-dividend-yield stocks can be the best bear-market performers (REC +15% in two weeks) - yield is a cushion and a signal.
When option writers dare to sell again (wide OI at round strikes with modest combined premium), volatility is expected to fall - until the next macro event.
quote: The best performer in the stock market for the last few months is ITC... even the high dividend yield stocks have been doing very well.
leaks: Dubai conference announcement: venue Armani/Ritz Carlton/Four Seasons, ~1 lakh + VAT fees, limited to 100 people, Google form (promo/self-reference)

summary: European strength bled into US futures; ICICI and IndusInd jumped on Q1 business updates; Kotak a laggard near range-bottom (1,700-1,900); SBI 435 to 475. FII futures short ~86%; government 'shock therapy' speculation (LTCG cut or STT removal, ~6,000-10,000 cr revenue) could ignite a squeeze like the 2019 corporate-tax 'candle'. Nifty reclaimed the 20-DMA; 16,000 resistance; high-dividend strategy (bought Manappuram, REC, PFC).

events.claim: FIIs held ~86% short in Nifty index futures on 5 Jul 2022
ICICI Bank and IndusInd Bank rallied sharply on Q1 FY23 business updates (early July 2022)
Government STT collection only ~6,000-10,000 crore annually - small enough to abolish as a market-friendly signal

lessons: In bear markets rotate to defensive/high-dividend names (IT, FMCG, pharma, utilities like PFC/REC); in bull markets chase growth - regime dictates style.
Cash-market holdings and F&O margins are not linked in India: a fully-hedged covered call still pays full span margin, unlike the US - a structural cost of selling covered calls in India.
quote: In a bullish market you go after the growth stocks; in a bearish market you go after the defensive stocks or high dividend yield stocks.
leaks: personal holdings disclosed (Manappuram, REC, PFC, TCS/Infosys) - genericize if used

summary: Nifty scaled 16,000 intraday (Bank Nifty-led) despite weak Europe, then reversed violently: Nifty -250, Bank Nifty -600 from highs on European selling. Surprise: FIIs were net BUYERS (1,295 cr) - first buy in roughly two months; DII small sellers. Rupee's ~10% depreciation makes sold-too-early FIIs re-look. Dow swung 500 points; Germany -2.5%. 'Hope is the worst enemy in the stock market.'

events.claim: FIIs turned net buyers (1,295 crore) on 5 Jul 2022 - first net-buy day in about two months
Nifty crossed 16,000 intraday on 5 Jul 2022 before reversing ~250 points
German DAX fell ~2.5% on 5 Jul 2022 without specific news

lessons: One FII net-buy day after months of selling is a data point, not a trend - they have faked reversals before; wait for a pattern.
Hope is the worst enemy in the stock market: plan exits by levels and data, never by wishes.
quote: Hope is the worst enemy in the stock market.

summary: Explains yield-curve inversion (2-year above 10-year) as a classic recession precursor; Dow swung ~1,200 points; crude -10% (WTI below $100); equities, commodities, crypto all sold together - possible capitulation. ICICI/HDFC Bank ADRs higher, banks look supported; Bajaj Finance business update strong. His Reliance fence: sold 2,500/2,600CE, bought 2,400PE financed by 2,300PE.

events.claim: US Treasury yield curve inverted (2-year above 10-year) in early July 2022 - a historical recession precursor
WTI crude fell below $100 and Brent dropped ~10% in early July 2022
Dollar index at 106, a 20-year high versus the euro (July 2022)

lessons: Markets bottom after capitulation, but you only recognize capitulation in hindsight - never assume one washout is the last.
Yield-curve inversion has preceded most recessions; it is a warning light, not a countdown timer.
quote: Usually after a big storm markets bottom out only after a capitulation period - but we do not know whether this is the real capitulation.

summary: Wild 45 minutes (300-point swing) then steady climb: first close above 16,000 in a long time (screen showed 15,989 on weighted average). Kotak +3% short covering; Bajaj Finance +4% on business update; call writers 15,800-16,000 forced to unwind; heavy put writing followed. Only energy (Reliance, ONGC, GAIL) lagged; FMCG rallied on palm oil, autos/paints on crude below $100. Next target 16,200 (50-DMA).

events.claim: Nifty closed above 16,000 on 6 Jul 2022 for the first time in weeks (official weighted-average print 15,989)
Kotak Bank rose ~3% and Bajaj Finance ~4% on 6 Jul 2022 (short covering / business update)

lessons: When sellers are trapped by a reversal, their forced unwinding extends the move - watch max-OI call strikes flip from resistance to trigger.
Crude below $100 is a sector rotation switch: autos, paints, plastics and FMCG benefit while energy lags.
quote: People who sold call options aggressively... today they all had to run for cover; all the put options saw huge writing.

summary: Fed minutes (50-75bp guidance) met a US rally; Brent back below $100; RBI relaxed NRE/FCNR deposit rate caps to defend the rupee. FII futures shorts eased 86% to ~77% after covering; December-option premiums falling = fewer expected big moves. Nifty above 20-DMA; 16,000-16,200 expected. High-dividend picks (REC 110 to ~129 plus 4.80 dividend) 'hide under yield until normalcy returns.'

events.claim: RBI removed interest-rate caps on NRE/FCNR(B) deposits in July 2022 to support the rupee
US Fed minutes (June meeting, released 6 Jul 2022) signaled 50bp or 75bp hikes 'depending on data'
FII short position in Nifty futures fell from ~86% to ~77% by 7 Jul 2022

lessons: Long-dated option premium behavior (December chain) reveals what the market expects months out - India VIX only reads one month.
A 16,000 short straddle can be made risk-free quickly: bank the decay, stop-loss at entry - predefined exits beat hope.
quote: Until market stabilizes, it is better to hide under high dividend yield stocks - the probability of their outperforming is very high compared to growth stocks.
leaks: personal positions (December options, REC) disclosed - genericize if used

summary: Broad risk-on: TCS short-covered past 3,300; Bank Nifty +1,200 over two days after Tuesday's 600-point afternoon collapse; PSU banks +3%; China prepone ~$220bn of next year's bond quota for infrastructure stimulus - metals (Tata Steel, JSW, Hindalco) +5-6%. UK market rose despite the PM resigning - everything pre-factored. Nifty closed above the 50-DMA (~16,160); next targets 16,600 (100-DMA), then ~17,100 (200-DMA).

events.claim: China announced ~$220 billion of additional infrastructure spending by preponeing next year's local-government special-bond quota (July 2022)
UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson announced resignation on 7 Jul 2022; UK equities rose
Nifty closed above its 50-day moving average (~16,160) on 7 Jul 2022; 100-DMA ~16,600, 200-DMA ~17,100

lessons: A market that rises on a resignation and on hawkish minutes is telling you negativity is fully priced - that is the anatomy of a relief rally.
When an index closes above its 50-DMA in a bear phase, the mechanical map forward is 100-DMA, then 200-DMA - let levels, not feelings, set targets.
quote: UK Prime Minister is resigning and the UK market went up - which means all these have been factored in already.
leaks: 'since I am going for a party I am just shooting this video' (personal)

summary: 750-point rally in five sessions despite Reliance's 2,800-to-2,400 fall (~1.5% index drag) - a bear-market relief rally below the 200-DMA (~17,100). 15,900 highest near OI; straddles traded at 16,100-16,200. FII shorts 86% down to ~74% - squeeze fuel remains. US jobs data + TCS results same evening. Covered-call financing of TCS/Infosys holdings; SEBI suggestion to link cash and F&O margins (US-style).

events.claim: Nifty rallied ~750 points in five sessions to ~16,250 (8 Jul 2022) while remaining below its 200-DMA (~17,100)
FII Nifty-futures short position eased from ~86% to ~74% by 8 Jul 2022
TCS Q1 results and US June jobs report due the same evening (8 Jul 2022)

lessons: Reliance's 12% index weight means its 12% stock fall subtracts ~1.5% from Nifty - heavyweight concentration distorts every index read.
A windfall-tax withdrawal (or any abrupt policy reversal) can gap a beaten heavyweight +4-5% and trap all its shorts - policy risk cuts both ways.
quote: Bull market corrections are fast and furious, and bear market relief rallies will also be fast and furious.
leaks: personal TCS/Infosys futures positions + covered calls - genericize if used

summary: Quietest session in weeks (smallest ATR): Nifty held 16,200 +/-30, VIX fell 4% below 20; straddle/strangle writers all profited. FII sold just 109 cr, DII bought 35 cr. TCS results after hours - mediocre, not disastrous; his TCS put ladder (buy 3,400PE, sell 3,200/3,100/3,000PE) positioned mildly bullish, willing to take delivery. US June payrolls beat; Dow futures -150 after. Range view 16,000-16,600.

events.claim: US June 2022 nonfarm payrolls beat expectations (released 8 Jul 2022)
TCS Q1 FY23 results (8 Jul 2022) were underwhelming but not sharply negative
India VIX fell ~4% to below 20 on 8 Jul 2022

lessons: An aggressively skewed put ladder (long far put financed by selling nearer puts) expresses a mildly bullish view with a known floor - define the breakeven before the event, not after.
After a binary event, IV collapse is the trade: enter ratio/straddle structures designed to profit from decay, then exit once the event passes.
quote: I bought 3,400 put and sold 3,200, 3,100 and 3,000 puts - I am slightly bullish, expecting TCS not to fall below 3,100.
leaks: personal TCS options position disclosed - genericize if used

summary: Week starts shaky: SGX 100 points off its morning high and below Friday's low; US CPI Wednesday and US bank results loom. Bank Nifty +1,500 in three sessions then Tuesday-style mean reversion risk; ICICI's +2% came with falling open interest = short covering, not fresh buying (his OI-price cross-check). Calls written aggressively 16,200-17,000; 16,000PE highest OI. Watch India VIX crossing 20 as the caution trigger.

events.claim: Bank Nifty rallied ~1,500 points in the three sessions to 8 Jul 2022
ICICI Bank rose ~2% on 8 Jul 2022 while its open interest fell - short covering, not fresh longs
US CPI (June) due 13 Jul 2022; US bank earnings due late that week

lessons: Price up + open interest down = short covering, not conviction buying - always cross-check price with OI before calling strength.
Rising open interest on call strikes every 100 points overhead maps out the resistance ladder - the crowd literally draws your ceiling.
quote: Calls are written aggressively across every strike starting from 16,200 to 17,000... there may be resistance at every level.

summary: Defied weak global cues (Hong Kong -3%): Bank Nifty surged on government plans to cut PSU-bank stakes from 51% to 26%; Adani-Vodafone Idea takeover speculation (his tweet) lifted Vodafone Idea and Adani Enterprises neared its all-time high while Nifty sat at 16,200. IT fell 3%. December-option premiums collapsed - his 16,000 December straddle booked 10 lakh+ MTM; 'probably I am the one creating the open interest in December options.'

events.claim: Government indicated willingness to cut PSU bank stakeholding from 51% to 26% (July 2022), sparking a PSU bank rally
Adani Enterprises traded near its all-time high in July 2022 while Nifty was ~13% off its peak
Speculation that Adani might acquire Vodafone Idea to enter telecom (11 Jul 2022)

lessons: Long-dated straddle premium collapse is the cleanest signal that the market expects smaller future moves - and it is tradable in December chains, not just weeklies.
Index level and stock reality can diverge violently (Adani Ent at ATH, Nifty -13%): index averages hide stock-specific manias.
quote: December option prices fell like anything... my MTM profit was more than 10 lakh rupees only in that one contract.
leaks: personal December straddle position (10L MTM) + 'I tweeted' references - genericize if used

summary: Volatility returns ahead of India CPI (today) and US CPI (Wednesday): US VIX +7% in a day; Tesla/Facebook/Amazon -4-6%; Nasdaq's five-day green streak broken. Yet December-chain premiums kept collapsing (Nifty -100 while far puts fell 30) - long-horizon calm. Monday's 100-point gap-down was absorbed in five minutes: 'some people know the news before you and me' (PSU stake story). Support 16,000; his 16,000 December straddle intact.

events.claim: US equity VIX jumped ~7% on 11 Jul 2022 ahead of CPI
India CPI (June) released 12 Jul 2022; US CPI due 13 Jul 2022
Tesla, Meta (Facebook), Amazon each fell ~4-6% on 11 Jul 2022

lessons: The far expiry chain is the smart-money thermometer: when 13,000-14,000 December puts get cheaper on a 100-point down day, the long horizon expects calm.
Fast absorption of a big gap-down minutes after open usually means informed buyers already knew the catalyst - note it, don't chase it.
quote: Stock market is a place where always some people know the news before you and me know - later we understood the reason.
leaks: 'I do have lot of 16,000 short straddle' - personal position, genericize if used

summary: India underperformed ahead of US CPI: Bank Nifty fell ~250-300 in the final 45 minutes; TCS slid toward 3,000 (from 4,000; buyback was at 4,500); Infosys the top drag. FII selling resumed (-1,565 cr), futures shorts back above 80%. TCS fell from ~4,000 (with a 4,500 buyback) toward 3,000 by mid-July 2022
FIIs' Nifty-futures short position rose back above 80% by 12 Jul 2022

leaks: personal September ratio position disclosed - genericize if used

summary: US CPI day. His contrarian law of markets: 'when I am scared and close everything, the market does not move; when I hold, it moves violently - the market rewards only the minority.' India VIX calm and December 13,000-14,000 puts falling despite Nifty -100 = knee-jerk reactions only, per the chain. FII futures shorts back to 80%+ (squeeze cushion). TCS below 3,000 = long-term buy; sell 3,000PE (~30-32) to take delivery cheap. Brent -7% below $100; metals active on possible export-duty removal; India CPI 7% vs US 8%+ a relative positive.

events.claim: US CPI (June 2022) released 13 Jul 2022; prior month's print had triggered a ~10% Nasdaq fall in 3-4 sessions
India CPI (June 2022) was ~7% vs US inflation above 8%
Brent crude fell ~7% to below $100 by 13 Jul 2022

lessons: The market is designed to reward the minority - the crowd's fear trade (puts, short calls into CPI) is itself the reason moves surprise it.
Selling slightly OTM puts on a quality stock you want to own is a paid entry order: collect premium, take delivery if assigned.
quote: As and when I am scared, I close all my positions - the market does not make a violent move... the market is always designed to reward only the minority.
